title: WynnPerf
description: A stable, lightweight, and high-performance WynnCraft modpack built on the Valkaw.
body:
The perfect blend of Valkaw performance and the RPG world of WynnCraft.


--- ## 📖 Introduction **WynnPerf** is an optimized modpack specifically tailored for adventurers in the kingdom of **WynnCraft**. Built on the foundation of **Valkaw**, we have implemented a "de-bloating" process—removing unnecessary mods to achieve the highest possible frame rates—while integrating advanced RPG support features for a smoother and more intuitive gameplay experience. --- ## 🛠️ Core Mod List
Category Functionality
Core Based on the lite version of Valkaw
Performance Sodium for OpenGL - VulkanMod for Vulkan API
Wynn Features Wynntils, WynnLantern, etc.
Visuals Iris Shaders (Sodium) - Beryl (VulkanMod)
--- ## 📥 Installation Guide ### 🟢 Modrinth App, MultiMC, Prims Launcher 1. Open the launcher that supports the Modrinth modpack format. 2. Search for **WynnPerf**. 3. Choose your preferred edition, either Sodium or VulkanMod, and the Minecraft version you want to play. 4. Click **Install** and hit play! ### 🛠️ Manual Installation 1. Install Fabric Loader from [fabricmc.net](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/). 2. Locate your Game Folder: open your launcher and find the "Game Directory" or "Open Folder" button. Standard path: `%appdata%\.minecraft` (Windows) or `~/Library/Application Support/minecraft` (macOS). 3. Extract Modpack Files: extract the ZIP file u download from GitHub and copy the following folders and files from the zip into your `.minecraft` directory: **mods - config - resourcepack - options.txt** 4. Allocate RAM: I recommend for playing WynnCraft is allocate 4GB of RAM * Go to **Settings** or **Edit Profile** in your launcher. * Find **JVM Arguments** or **Memory Allocation**. * Change `-Xmx1G` to `-Xmx4G` or `-Xmx6G`. > Backup for **mods** folder before install my modpack
